{{Quote|What is your command?|Wittin's B1-Series battle droid|<ref name="Demolition">[[Star Wars: Demolition: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Demolition'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>}}
'''Wittin''' was a barbaric [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] warlord whose large tribe profited from robbing travelers and committing other foul deeds like plundering [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]], earning him a place as the most feared ones on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|These Jawas follow a leader called Wittin. They're not like other Jawas&mdash;they're mean.|[[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Kitster Banai|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
[[File:Wittin.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Wittin with his remote control]]
For many years, inhabitants of Tatooine quaked in fear at the sight of his massive [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] roaming the dunes until it was destroyed in a skirmish with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops, who were attacking sandcrawlers randomly in search of [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] offered to buy him a new sandcrawler if Wittin won his demolition contest.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Wittin got involved in a plot to kill the former [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]]. A slaver named [[Drik Bandrik]], determined to destroy Kitster, tricked Wittin's tribe of Jawas into believing that he had stolen a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] from them. Wittin therefore sent a band of Jawa to kill Banai. However, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for Kitster killed Wittin's enforcers before they could reach Banai in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].<ref name="SWG:KB" />

Years later, around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Wittin entered [[Jabba's demolition games|Jabba's demolition contest]] using a remote-controlled [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] on a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAP]], as he was not willing to risk his own neck. He added some upgrades to his vehicle, such as his [[ion double blaster]], which immobilized the target and knocked it down, doing damage as well. In addition to this, his special weapon also relieved the target of any droid supporting it.<ref name="rotj" />

[[File:Wittin_FFGCG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Wittin wielding an [[Jawa ionization blaster|ion blaster]]]]
Later that year, Wittin was in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] while [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] attempted to rescue [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from his [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] prison. Around that time, he was plotting with Jabba to take control of a neighboring tribe's territory.<ref name="rotj" />

He was on board Jabba's sail barge, the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']], during the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]]. Though he himself was killed during the sail barge's destruction, his terrorizing ways continued unabated.<ref name="rotj" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wittin_SWI_60.jpg|thumb|left|120px|Wittin]]
To unlock him in ''Demolition'', you need to score an ultimate victory with both [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] and [[Quagga]].

According to ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Jawas]]'', Wittin's terrorizing ways continued, despite ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 23]]'' stating that he died during the skirmish at Carkoon. However, the article never explicitly stated Wittin survived. As a result, it is assumed both are true within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]].

The article ''[[Who's Who in Jabba's Palace]]'', published in [[Star Wars Insider 60|''Star Wars Insider'' 60]], stated in [[Kalit/Legends|Kalit's]] entry that Jabba's death forced Wittin and Kalit to solve their problems with each other, despite [[The Official Star Wars Fact File|''Fact File'']] issue 23 establishing that Wittin was killed when the ''Khetanna'' was destroyed, which was minutes after the Hutt's death.
